c: Being a Belnades' Spellbook weapon, Hex has a charge time before activation, which is indicated by the brightness of its created magic circle.

Hex summons a purple magic circle a fixed distance away from the character's faced direction. When fully charged, it summons a skull that damages enemies in its immediate area. It then fires, in bursts, multiple wavy horizontally-moving runic projectiles from its mouth that damage enemies they touch.
affects how many bursts it fires before disappearing.

Hex has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same projectile. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
